description: The public reviews on one person's profile, the same ones the site shows: star ratings (overall, personality, policy, effectiveness), the review text, the date and the reviewer's public username (or "Anonymous"). Newest first by default; sort by highest, lowest or helpful. Hidden and flagged reviews are never included. Voluntary crowdsourced opinions, not a poll; quote them as one member's view.
name: list_reviews
title: List reviews on a profile
